class.name: TerminalPlugin
class.brief_description: A Godot editor plugin that provides terminal emulation capabilities in the editor's bottom panel.
class.description:
The TerminalPlugin extends EditorPlugin to add a fully-featured terminal emulator to the Godot editor. It creates a multi-tab terminal interface in the editor's bottom panel, allowing developers to run shell commands, scripts, and interactive applications directly within the editor environment.
Features include: - Multi-tab terminal interface with support for different shell types - Automatic detection of available shells (zsh, bash, PowerShell, etc.) - Copy/paste functionality with system clipboard integration - Scrollback buffer with mouse wheel and touchpad scrolling support - Real-time terminal size display - Customizable terminal appearance with theme integration - Support for VT100 and xterm protocols through the underlying GDTerm component
The plugin automatically detects available terminals on the system and provides a dropdown to select the preferred shell when creating new terminal tabs. It maintains proper focus handling and integrates seamlessly with the Godot editor's UI theming system.

method.name: add_terminal_tab
method.description: Add a terminal tab with the given name and optional shell path. If shell_path is empty, the default shell will be used.

method.name: close_tab
method.description: Close the terminal tab at the given index. Returns true if successful, false if the index is invalid.

method.name: get_current_tab_index
method.description: Get the index of the currently active terminal tab.

method.name: get_tab_count
method.description: Get the total number of open terminal tabs.

method.name: get_tab_name
method.description: Get the name of the terminal tab at the given index.

method.name: get_terminal
method.description: Get the GDTerm instance for the terminal tab at the specified index.

method.name: move_tab
method.description: Move the terminal tab from one index to another.

method.name: run_command_in_current_tab
method.description: Run the given command in the currently active terminal tab.

method.name: run_command_in_tab
method.description: Run the given command in the terminal tab at the specified index.

method.name: set_current_tab
method.description: Set the currently active terminal tab to the one at the specified index.
